pages.text: Over the next few pages, you will find information on the various jewelry enchantments, what their max level is and descriptions on what they do.
pages.title: Enchantments

pages.text: $(l)Sonic the Hedgehog (MAX 5)$()$(br)Faster while sprinting on the ground.$(br2)$(l)Leapfrog (MAX 4)$()$(br)Jump higher; wears every 10 jumps.$(br2)$(l)Step Up (MAX 3)$()$(br)Walk up 1 extra block per level.
$(l)Fall Resistance (MAX 4)$()$(br)Greater protection from fall damage the higher the level.$(br2)$(l)Spiderman (MAX 1)$()$(br)Climb walls by walking into them.
$(l)Paraglide (MAX 2)$()$(br)Slows your fall while you are not sneaking. Sneak to drop normally.$(br2)$(l)Superman (MAX 3)$()
Grants the power of flight (double jump to take off). Wears while you fly.

$(l)Reaper (MAX 3)$()$(br)Level 1: items kept on death; Level 2: respawn where you died; Level 3: a short immunity after respawning.$(br2)$(l)Blink (MAX 3)$()$(br)Press the Blink key (V by default) while looking at a block to teleport on top of it, up to 16 blocks per level.$(br2)$(l)Restoration (MAX 3)$()
Repairs items at the cost of durability on jewelry. Level 1: Repairs held Item; Level 2: Repairs Hotbar; Level 3: Repairs Armour.

$(l)1 Up (MAX 3)$()$(br)If you die, you don't die. You will be revived instantly, and your health restored up to the level of this enchant.$(br2)$(l)Never Hungry (MAX 5)$()$(br)Restores your hunger bar. Level affects how much saturation is provided, therefore how long each feed lasts.
